fields.description: Shopware payment method shortName/name. Match is case-insensitive and ignores spaces/hyphens. Partial matches are supported (e.g. 'pay_pal' matches 'pay_pal_payment_handler').
fields.label: Shopware Method

fields.description: Tick for methods where the customer pays out-of-band after placing the order (Vorkasse, Rechnung/Kauf auf Rechnung, SEPA-Lastschrift mit Pre-Auth). For these the Auftragsbestätigung is sent as soon as the order is placed, even while the payment is still 'Unpaid'. Leave unticked for instant-clearing methods (PayPal, Klarna, Karte, Apple/Google Pay) where the order acknowledgment must wait until the payment is actually 'Paid' — otherwise a customer with a stuck or failing PayPal/Klarna flow would receive a confirmation for an order that may never settle.
fields.label: Customer pays out-of-band (Vorkasse / Rechnung)
